setup: You are multiplying $\frac{[[num]]}{[[den]]}$ by the whole number [[whole]].

steps.say: Multiplying by a whole number means counting the fraction that many times, so the top goes up: [[num]] × [[whole]] = [[raw_num]].
The bottom [[raw_den]] is unchanged — [[whole]]/1 in disguise, and 1 leaves any denominator alone.
